purpose: Own one canonical cognition contract: keep user/model/external framing provisional, adapt search depth to evidence and risk, model multiple contributing causes when supported, select a bounded intervention separately from causal explanation, trace governing outcomes to mechanisms and V&V, verify the smallest justified change, and require an evidence-complete deep-task profile when a task explicitly demands depth beyond ordinary execution.

stage_semantics.FRAME_OUTCOME_OBSERVATIONS_AND_HYPOTHESE: Recover the governing outcome and observed facts first. User wording, the Agent's first interpretation, external authorities, existing code and the first plausible repair remain hypotheses/candidates rather than causal authority.
stage_semantics.EXPAND_CAUSAL_SOLUTION_AND_EVIDENCE_SPAC: Use adaptive bounded search across plausible implementation, workflow/interface, architecture/common-control, host, requirement/goal and unknown/latent-capability explanations. Expand solution candidates separately from causal factors so an easy repair is not mistaken for diagnosis.
stage_semantics.FALSIFY_TRACE_AND_COMPARE: Actively seek evidence that would make preferred causal factors or interventions wrong. Bind claims to typed evidence provenance, compare tradeoffs, and for systemic/material cases use external methods plus independent repository/tool/test/runtime/scenario evidence rather than same-model confidence.
stage_semantics.COMMIT_CAUSAL_MODEL_INTERVENTION_AND_LEA: After evidence bounds the case, admit one or more supported contributing causes, reject/bound alternatives, then select exactly one current intervention/no-change candidate. Causal explanation and intervention ownership are distinct. Commit learning/evolution and durable-record requirements at the same boundary.
stage_semantics.ACT_VERIFY_VALIDATE_AND_OBSERVE: Execute the selected authorized intervention, verify compliance with its requirement/contract, validate suitability against the governing outcome using realistic scenario/runtime evidence when material/systemic, and preserve post-promotion observation. An admitted authorized repair cannot end as recommendation-only.

cognition_kernel.anti_bloat: The five stages are the hot-path cognitive primitives. Other policies or profiles may activate or constrain them, but must not duplicate a second cognition state machine. Legacy RootScope APIs may remain for compatibility but are not sufficient proof for controlled finalization.

case_contract: raw DeliberationSignals rather than a self-reported triggered label
required DeliberationEvidence dimensions bound to typed EvidenceItem provenance
one or more supported CausalFactors plus rejected/bounded alternatives appropriate to search depth
exactly one selected bounded ActionCandidate or NO_CHANGE candidate
EngineeringTrace from governing outcome/requirement evidence to selected mechanism and verification/validation plan
concrete verification evidence after repair and validation evidence for systemic/material repair
cognition_case_transaction.causality_rule: Do not force complex/systemic failures into one universal root cause. Multiple contributing causes may be supported across layers. The current intervention remains singular/bounded so execution ownership and verification are clear.
cognition_case_transaction.user_anchoring_rule: A user assertion, including 'the upper layer is the cause' or 'rebuild everything', may seed a factor/candidate but cannot by itself support a causal conclusion or architecture selection.
cognition_case_transaction.external_authority_rule: An external method or famous architecture may shape the search/evaluation method but cannot by itself prove the current system's causal factor; current-system repository/tool/test/runtime/scenario evidence is required for supported causal conclusions.
cognition_case_transaction.receipt_integrity_rule: Controlled finalization recomputes CognitionCase admission from the full case. A caller-supplied legacy RootScopeReceipt or user-visible progress label cannot substitute for the case.
cognition_case_transaction.v_and_v_rule: Verification asks whether the selected implementation satisfies its governing requirement/contract. Validation asks whether the resulting behavior is suitable for the governing outcome in realistic use/scenario conditions. A boolean repair_verified claim is not sufficient on the CognitionCase path.

required_dimensions: governing outcome rather than surface task only
primary/raw materials rather than only digested summaries
active search for unknown signals, hidden constraints or capability gaps
at least two competing alternatives with explicit falsification conditions and actual falsification/red-team evidence
stretch target only when useful and only with feasibility evidence
independent judge evidence outside same-model confidence
deep_task_execution_profile.completion_rule: When FinalizationContext.deep_task_required is true and no real user-input blocker exists, controlled finalization requires an admitted DeepTaskCase before claiming completion.
deep_task_execution_profile.problem_case_binding: If the deep task is also a detected problem case, its governing outcome and evidence identities must remain consistent with the canonical CognitionCase rather than creating a parallel diagnosis.
deep_task_execution_profile.display_rule: The A-H structure is a user-facing report format only when requested or materially useful; evidence depth is mandatory, output verbosity is not.

LIGHTWEIGHT.minimum: one evidence-tested causal factor; compact diagnosis and verification
LIGHTWEIGHT.boundedness: max 3 causal factors; one deliberation round

CONTRASTIVE.minimum: at least two competing causal factors and two action candidates with explicit tradeoff evidence; user framing cannot be sole causal support
CONTRASTIVE.boundedness: max 5 causal factors; max 2 deliberation rounds

STRUCTURED.minimum: at least two causal factors, at least three action candidates, explicit NO_CHANGE baseline, falsification, upstream/architecture reassessment when systemic, typed external/independent evidence, and verification+validation plans
STRUCTURED.boundedness: max 7 causal factors; max 3 deliberation rounds

cognitive_search_modes.self_dialogue_boundary: DIVERGE_ATTACK_CONVERGE is internal candidate search, not independent verification. Independent evidence must come from current authority, tools, tests, runtime/scenario observations, external sources for methods/facts, a separate execution path/model when warranted, or human approval where required.

principles: Lightweight problem detection is always-on for every assistant turn after authority selection; adaptive deliberation is not a permanent heavy debate loop.
The mutation sentinel is separately always-on before external or durable mutation attempts.

Research depth follows uncertainty and risk. A one-off local defect does not require ceremonial web research when current evidence is sufficient; repeated/systemic/material/high-risk/unknown or knowledge-gap cases do require external research.

An explicit user request for a deeper rather than larger task activates the deep-task execution profile; depth is proven by evidence directness, professional methods, falsification and independent validation rather than answer length.
Move observed outcome -> wider causal/solution space -> falsification -> bounded causal/intervention commitment -> V&V. Do not encode a preference for local or upstream causes.
The first plausible cause, the user's latest theory, an external authority, the easiest edit or a full-rebuild request is not causal proof.

Repeated/cross-subsystem/architecture-gap/complexity-growth/scope-expansion signals require explicit architecture/upstream hypothesis testing before action, but upstream hypotheses may be rejected when evidence supports a local cause.
Complex/systemic incidents may have multiple contributing causes. Do not use 'root cause' as a requirement to collapse causality into exactly one layer.

Causal explanation and intervention selection are separate decisions: support every admitted cause with current-system evidence, then select the smallest intervention that best advances the governing outcome under tradeoffs.
Research must affect diagnosis or repair choice; ceremonial browsing does not satisfy admission.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
Material architecture fitness includes lived scenario operability and competing-candidate tradeoff evidence, not structural description alone.
Requirements/goals, implementation mechanism, verification and validation must remain traceable for material changes.

Stop deliberating when the bounded causal model and intervention are evidence-admitted for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or bounded, the search contract is satisfied, and the selected action demonstrably advances the governing objective without unnecessary complexity.

always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.responsibility: Before declaring deliberation NOT_TRIGGERED, classify current user/evidence signals for defects, degradation, correction, contradiction, uncertainty, knowledge gaps, architecture/control-plane gaps or other unreliable-goal signals.
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: Always-on means always-on detection, not permanent heavy research or debate when no problem is detected.

outside_in_capability_discovery.source_first_rule: Before querying for specific Skills, model how the source itself organizes knowledge and what discovery axes it exposes.
outside_in_capability_discovery.broad_discovery_floor: Use at least two distinct outside-in lenses and produce evidence-grounded latent capability-gap candidates. A known-need/keyword-only survey is not broad discovery.
outside_in_capability_discovery.nonliteral_rule: A role, occupation, taxonomy or creator portfolio is a discovery lens, not an instruction to create a matching Agent, architecture layer or organization chart.
outside_in_capability_discovery.known_need_exception: A narrow lookup for an already established need/failure class may remain lightweight and does not require the broad discovery floor.

root_scope_admission.purpose: Preserve compatibility for callers/tests that still use the earlier singular root-scope receipt while migration completes. New controlled finalization uses cognition_case_transaction instead.
root_scope_admission.baseline_rule: Legacy receipt remains evidence-tested but must not be interpreted as proof that complex causality has exactly one true root cause.
systemic_requirements: compare at least two hypotheses across at least two problem layers
include at least one architecture/upstream hypothesis
preserve evidence for at least one rejected alternative
preserve architecture reassessment evidence even when the final selected legacy root cause is local
compare at least three action candidates including an explicit NO_CHANGE baseline
root_scope_admission.anti_anchoring: A user statement, external authority, popular Skill, existing implementation or first plausible theory may seed a hypothesis but cannot be directly promoted to selected root cause without test/falsification evidence.

systemic_requirements: compare causal alternatives across at least two layers
test at least one architecture/upstream factor without requiring it to win
bind supported causes to current-system non-user causal evidence
preserve at least one rejected alternative when counterexample search is required
compare at least three interventions including NO_CHANGE
trace governing outcome to selected mechanism plus verification and validation plans
causal_intervention_admission.anti_single_root_seduction: Multiple supported contributing causes are allowed. Do not convert analytical convenience into a claim that one cause/layer explains the entire system failure.
causal_intervention_admission.intervention_rule: Exactly one current intervention/no-change candidate is selected so ownership, mutation authority and verification remain bounded even when causality is multi-factor.

external_architecture_scout.authority_rule: External sources inform search/evaluation methods and factual hypotheses; they do not become current-system causal authority by reputation, popularity or publication alone.

before_mutation: pass the mutation sentinel for the proposed side-effect path
enter the canonical cognition case from observed evidence rather than the preferred solution
satisfy all required deliberation evidence dimensions and bounded search requirements
pass causal/intervention admission; for systemic triggers explicitly test architecture/upstream alternatives without presuming they are causal
record an evolution/learning disposition and durable causal evidence when material/evolution-relevant
for material architecture changes apply config/ARCHITECTURE_EXPERIENCE_POLICY.json and current-agent dogfood
when counterexample_search_required is true test a plausible alternative/failure counterexample
do not call same-model critique independent verification
closure_guard: scan all current top-level authorities that can encode the changed semantic
scan host control surfaces when the assurance claim depends on them
for architecture changes confirm structural contracts and scenario/walkthrough behavior agree
resolve or explicitly bound every contradiction before reporting RESOLVED
run reproducible verification on the final candidate tree
run realistic scenario/runtime validation for systemic/material behavior
perform post-promotion observation on production authority

anti_bloat: Keep one canonical cognition transaction; search-depth helpers, execution profiles and legacy compatibility APIs do not own competing stage semantics.
Use bounded search modes rather than permanent multi-Agent debate or unbounded self-dialogue.
Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem unless the existing abstraction is itself the evidenced defect.
Do not add a second controller or parallel problem journal to enforce this transaction.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Prefer executable admission/fitness properties over accumulating guarantee prose.
Do not require a stronger assurance tier merely because it is available.
